thread:
Alex: quick Q — the new /v1/inference response includes a usage breakdown (prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, cached_tokens). Are we sure this is non-breaking for clients that read total_tokens? Some SDKs assume total_tokens == prompt + completion.

Marta: @Alex good call. We're adding cached_tokens to make cache hits visible. total_tokens will remain but we should clarify semantics: total_tokens will represent prompt + completion (what the model actually generated/consumed), cached_tokens represents tokens served from prefix/KV cache and should not be double-counted for billing.

Sam: from billing perspective the important value is billable_tokens = prompt_tokens + completion_tokens - cached_tokens. We'll publish that mapping in the API contract. Cached tokens should reduce chargeable units.

Kelly: implementation note — runtime currently returns the "usage" object in JSON body. I propose we also add a short header (X-Redwood-Token-Accounting) with a compact CSV summary so proxies/edge logs can capture it cheaply. Example body: 

```json
{
  "id": "resp_...",
  "object": "inference",
  "usage": {
    "prompt_tokens": 120,
    "completion_tokens": 80,
    "cached_tokens": 50,
    "total_tokens": 200,
    "billable_tokens": 150
  },
  "choices": [ ... ]
}
```

Kelly: header example: `X-Redwood-Token-Accounting: billable=150;prompt=120;completion=80;cached=50`

Alex: two follow-ups: 1) update the API spec / changelog. 2) Clients that compute total_tokens by summing everything may break reconciliation. Do we want to mark total_tokens as deprecated for billing usage, or add a field that indicates which field to use for charges?

Marta: we'll explicitly add billable_tokens (as above) and a short note in the response docs: "Use billable_tokens for billing; total_tokens kept for compatibility and represents model IO only." That should be additive-only (no breaking changes).

Sam: also, for accounting reconciliation we'll add a boolean `billable_is_inclusive` in the spec? Might be overkill. Alternatively, publishing the exact formula in the docs should suffice. Accounting will run a reconciliation check post-deploy.

Kelly: I'll send a PR to runtime to: 1) include billable_tokens in usage, 2) add the header, 3) bump the OpenAPI example. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/1234 (WIP).

infra-bot: deploy scheduled to staging at 2029-05-12T15:20Z (deploy-5678) :rocket:

Marta: leaving this async — @Alex please review the spec PR when Kelly pings. I'll update the docs page (api/usage.md) with the exact formula and an example reconciliation snippet for finance.

Sam: FYI accounting will run a reconciliation job for the last 7 days after the staging deploy to validate numbers and catch edge cases (cached across model variants, routing fallbacks).

Alex: sounds good, thanks folks. I'll review the spec PR tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:

Kelly: pinging here when PR is ready for review. :eyes:
